text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Kitasan Black ready to<n>head out in a
large group. I go over to<n>her, curious to know
what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We're going to help everyone at the<n>shopping
district!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can usually handle it alone, but the<n>requests have
really piled up today...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita was a little sheepish about<n>asking for help, but
luckily I was there<n>to round everyone up. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm thrilled that you're relying on us.<n>I'm ready 'n'
rar'n to lend a helping<n>hand!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes indeed. The people at the<n>shopping district do a
lot for us as<n>well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty hard to say no to Kita and<n>Dia, so here I
am!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, they promised to help me<n>search for
medicinal herbs in return!<n>And they better not even
think about<n>forgetting that part!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. All right everyone, today we<n>are the clutch
captain's dutiful<n>assistants! ♪
choice_data_list: Let me be an assistant, too!
Let me be an assistant, too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wow, so you wanna help out too?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, everyone! Okay,<n>let's get to
work!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's much to do—tidying up<n>storehouses,
repotting bonsai trees,<n>checking in on the elderly
who live<n>alone...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Deary me, they must really depend<n>on you, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Still, it's rare to have this<n>many errands in
one day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're too much of a pushover.<n>Don't come crying
to me when you<n>get yourself roped into something
diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sure she'll be fine. The people<n>in the
shopping district are all nice<n>people.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Getting back to the matter at hand,<n>how should we
handle these tasks? I<n>suppose splitting up the work
seems<n>optimal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I know! How about we have<n>ourselves a little
contest?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We'll form three teams and compete<n>to see who
can finish their tasks the<n>fastest!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah, that sounds like fun! Just<n>one thing,
though—my victory's all but<n>guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Special Week is paired up<n>with Grass
Wonder, Satono Diamond<n>with Sweep Tosho, and
me with<n>Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We eagerly dash off to help the folks<n>of the
shopping district, but before<n>long...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've put out all the beer bottles in<n>front of your
shop, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What are you holding there?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a customer left this behind. I hope<n>she comes
back for it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, that won't do...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'll go and pass it along<n>to them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, time for a quick run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With every stop, we leave with more<n>work to do. In
the end, our team is the<n>last to finish up...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's the shrine all cleaned<n>up. Now we're
finally done for the<n>day.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
After how long all that took, we<n>definitely came last,
huh... Sorry about<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? You're the<n>ones who
deserve first place!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dia! And when did you all get<n>here?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We might not've appreciated how<n>incredible you
really are! Everyone in<n>the shopping district was
singing your<n>praises wherever we went!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
When my back gave out, Kitasan<n>offered to carry
my heavy boxes.<n>She's a kind soul.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper C
text_block_list.text:
It was lonely all on my own after my<n>son moved
overseas with his wife<n>and children. But it made me
so<n>happy when Kitasan came to check in<n>on me...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Everyone said pretty much the samething—they're thrilled to have youaround.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Our one day of work hardly compares<n>to your
consistent efforts, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's why we think first place<n>should go to you
and your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're making me blush! But<n>it's nice
knowing I've made a<n>difference around here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm motivated to put in double<n>the effort in
helping out and keeping<n>everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black clenches her fists with<n>determination.
A soft breeze flows<n>through the shrine grounds—its
presence, perhaps, a show of<n>gratitude.
